messages:
Maya (AE): Hi team — Julian from Acme Financials signed up for a 4-week POC. They want a taxonomy-driven Q&A assistant over docs + customer data. Need to align success criteria, model fit, and security asks. Can we sync on scope?
Raj (Solutions Eng): Congrats Maya. Key questions: expected query latency SLO? Query volume (qps)? Are retrievals embeddings + rerank or simple BM25?
Julian (Customer): Thanks — target 200 QPS peak, average 40 QPS. Latency target <= 600ms 95th. Retrieval should use embeddings + reranker for legal precision. Also need tool-calling for a DB lookup to surface account metadata.
Maya (AE): Good. Timeline: kickoff Mon, week1 index + eval prompts, week2 integrate embeddings + rerank, week3 add tool-calling + security review, week4 final report + runway. Budget: they're evaluating Dedicated or Private; they asked about pricing ballpark for Dedicated for this traffic.
Liam (Sales Eng): For Dedicated sizing rough calc: 200 QPS with embeddings + rerank and 8k context could be 2x A100-class nodes with autoscale buffer. Ballpark monthly reserved ~$40-60k depending on commit. I can send formal quote.
Marta (ML Eng): Model selection notes: They need long context (up to 8k), tool-calling, and reliable factuality. Recommend trying a 8k-16k open model (quantized) for latency, with an L2 reranker using a smaller cross-encoder. If budget allows, eval a 32k commercial variant for very long multi-doc answers.
Raj (Solutions Eng): For tool-calling, we can use our function-calling shim. Need to confirm whether DB lookups must be on-prem. If yes, Private deployment or VPC with connector. Also we should define prompt/eval set: 50 core queries + 20 adversarial/legal queries.
Julian (Customer): DB must stay in their VPC. Audit logs and KMS required. They will send the security questionnaire after kickoff.
security-bot: Reminder: we require vendor security questionnaire to be uploaded to the portal. For Private deployments, collect KMS ARN and SOC2 report.
Marta (ML Eng): POC success criteria proposal: 1) 95th percentile user-visible latency < 800ms for simple Qs, < 2s for multi-doc synthesis; 2) Retriever+reranker F1 > 0.78 on eval set; 3) Tool-calling accuracy (correct DB row returned) > 98% on sample; 4) No P0 security gaps per questionnaire.
Liam (Sales Eng): Action items: I’ll draft a SOW with pricing options (Hosted + Dedicated + Private) and the node sizing assumptions. Raj/Marta please add technical tasks and eval plan. Julian — once you share the sec questionnaire we’ll loop in security.
Raj (Solutions Eng): I’ll put together an eval harness and a prompt suite. Example eval prompt snippet:```prompt\nUser: "Show me the latest compliance note for account ACME-123 and summarize liability clauses."\nExpected: list doc id, 3-line summary, and DB lookup result for account status.```
Maya (AE): Perfect. Can we aim to have the SOW + eval plan by Wed EOD so they can greenlight credits and infra?
Julian (Customer): Wed EOD works. I’ll upload the sec questionnaire today. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Marta (ML Eng): Quick model checklist before Wed: context length test, tokenization parity (customer docs), embedding model choice (sentence-transformers vs. dense), and a small rerank cross-encoder smoke test. I’ll add those to the eval doc.
Liam (Sales Eng): Noted. I'll include contract terms around data residency.
Maya (AE): Great thread. Tagging next steps: @Raj @Marta build eval pack, @Liam draft SOW, @Julian upload questionnaire. Meeting to review SOW Thu 10am PT.
